_readme: THE PICTURE VARIABLE SHEET: every input a picture chain takes, in the order of the prompt's sections. A recipe is this sheet filled in. Rules: see `rules` (PSH-1 to PSH-11). The 29 creative dials and the 9 guards are added from components/creative-controls/controls.json when the sheet loads. Kinds: text (a non-empty line), choice (one of `allowed`), list (a list; `allowed` limits its items when given), level (a dial level), on (a guard: only 'on'), yesno ('yes: <where>' or 'no: <reason>'), swaps (the swap rows).

dial_na: not used in a still picture
not applicable to the picture prompt: acts on the writing, already carried by the swaps and the words
the brief sets no level for this dial and the ad does not use it
required_dials_why: PSH-3 (guard dials set): the guards relevance, legibility and never-sterile read these dials.
locked_why: PSH-7 (one sheet per scene): these stay identical across a frame set; only the declared change differs.

rules.rule: Every variable is FILLED with an allowed value or NOT_APPLICABLE with an allowed reason. A MISSING variable stops the chain before any spend, with one plain line naming it.

fill_defaults fills every variable the brief, its brand step and the house files already state, so the sheet is complete before the gate runs; only what no file states is left for a person or the strategy.
The dials the guards read (intensity, absurdity, humor, dramatisation, stopping power) and every guard are never not-applicable.
A floor dial is never set under the never-sterile floor in controls.json.
A picture the system made may go into another picture only with a chosen record (its recipe beside it, marked chosen). A below_criteria flag on it is allowed and travels downstream.

Every FILLED variable reaches the model: the dials, feelings, techniques and keep lines go in labelled lines of THE PICTURE, inside the prompt length limit. NOT_APPLICABLE variables are recorded and not sent.
Pictures that feed one video scene come from one sheet: the locked variables stay identical and only the declared change differs.

Output checks (the judge, the frame-pair match) score attempts and never stop a flow: up to `output_checks.max_attempts` attempts, then the best-scoring one is chosen and marked below_criteria with the plain names of the checks it failed.
The picture model is sent only what to draw: no markdown, tables, explanations, the source's old words, counts or self-checks.

A dial with a visual meaning for a still goes to the model as one concrete picture instruction (picture-dials.json); a dial that acts on the writing stays on the sheet and reaches the picture through the swaps and words; film dials are not applicable to a still; a dial's level definition is never sent verbatim.

The pictures that go in are worked out from the run's swap list: the swipe as the layout, one cast photo per cast swap (and its reference sheet when the rulebook takes its file type), product photos only when the product is in the frame and only the sides named, one library photo per library swap, nothing for a drawn or words swap. A run with no swap list, or a cast or library swap whose picture is not on file, is MISSING. A cast swap says the person in IMAGE n is the cast member and keeps the face; a lookalike line is only for a lookalike. Words set on top after: the prompt asks for no writing anywhere and the words block is left out.
